title: Complete original descriptors for faithful current registration
question: Are original titles, metadata and current document keys available alongside verified binary originals?
method: Exact-target repeatable-read read-only census of original descriptors including title and meta::text; current exact JSON codec and filesystem SHA256; no generated output reads or database mutations.

outputs.role: Original registration input snapshot with titles and metadata

conclusion: All 29 registrations have titles and original metadata, verified local file hashes and keys matching the current document_key function. These are raw PDFs, not Chandra OCR outputs. The snapshot supplies finite normal-purpose registration inputs, not imported/generated results, writer fencing, activation or cutover. Revalidate before fencing if original descriptors change.
